'''Alwhin''' was ''[[so'jhin]]'' to [[High Lord|High Lady]] [[Suroth]]. She was from [[Seanchan]] and was previously a ''[[sul'dam]]''. 

== Appearance ==
She had a sharp face and thin lips with blue eyes and the left side of her head shaved.

== Activities ==
Alwhin finds [[Renna]] and [[Seta]], two ''sul'dam'', collared by an ''[[a'dam]]''.  She frees them and reveals the shocking information only to Suroth, who then decides to raise Alwhin to ''so'jhin'' in a bid to buy her silence.{{ref/book|4|1}}

She accompanies Suroth to [[Ebou Dar]] and even though she is Suroth's Voice, she has [[Liandrin]] on an ''a'dam''.

Liandrin, hoping to please Suroth, poisons Alwhin in order to end Alwhin's "blackmail" of revealing ''a'dam'' as capable of holding ''sul'dam''.

==In the television series==
In the television series, {{TVlink|Alwhin}} is played by actress {{TVlink|Jessica Boone}}.
